overlap_groups.name: authority-selection-lineage
overlap_groups.interpretation: These are sequential controls on the same synthetic authority-selection family. The corrected v2 counterfactual supersedes the fixed-width exploratory result; D1 and S4 establish causally valid decision interfaces, while late candidate-pointer authority remains inaccessible.

overlap_groups.name: positional-training-lineage
overlap_groups.interpretation: These experiments reuse the A0/A1/A2/A3 task family. They should not be pooled as independent tests; later runs refine the distinction between interface shift and training-distribution effects.

overlap_groups.name: digitwise-transfer-lineage
overlap_groups.interpretation: These are related diagonal-addition controls with shared task vocabulary and splits. Their pooled observations are correlated and the ablation controls retain explicit marginal-frequency limitations.

overlap_groups.name: role-binding-lineage
overlap_groups.interpretation: The sequence moves from learned parsing to pointer supervision and authority cues. Positive pointer performance on familiar layouts does not establish transferable authority resolution.

overlap_groups.name: cardinality-lineage
overlap_groups.interpretation: The first run failed paired four-candidate transfer. The explicit-ID follow-up failed training competence, so it cannot adjudicate shared scoring versus fixed-slot transfer. The isolated two-candidate gate establishes training competence for the cyclic schedule but leaves a validation transfer gap. The 2x2 audit weakens a padding-only explanation, the matched-context probe shows a familiar-versus-recombined candidate-set contrast on the same source context strata, and identifier forensics localizes errors to a few unordered families without proving memorization or a mechanism. The rotated pair-coverage run shows all arms can fit training but held-out paired transfer remains incomplete and seed-by-panel dependent. The complete crossover supports training-partner/coverage-graph dependence within the tested two-candidate graph. The nested coverage-density run does not show a monotonic benefit at a fixed row budget and confounds coverage with per-pair repetition, degree and connectivity; variable-cardinality transfer remains unresolved.

overlap_groups.name: relational-topology-control-lineage
overlap_groups.interpretation: This is a separate edge-offset composition task, not a direct identifier-matching continuation. The graph feasibility and path-consistency controls passed, but only one of four arms reached training competence, so the matched-diameter comparison is not adjudicated.
